_comment: THE FINALE vs A PENDING MERGE (coordinator fix round 1). The one collision the finale's bed hook has to survive: UI_SLEEP_VEIL_FINISHED is what tells consolidation_prompt.gd to show its modal, so a sleep that both OWES the ending and OFFERS a consolidation would have dropped the finale's black straight over that choice. Loads finale_merge_start (Act V TALK-path resolution already banked, parked on the inn bed at exactly the [Spellsword] gate) and drives the collision live: sleep -> the offer -> the veil voices it -> the prompt opens with the curtain PROVEN still down -> decline -> the finale rolls immediately, that same night, at 9 lines. Also pins that a declined merge leaves both parent classes standing in the recount. No combat, no rng dependence.

steps._comment: Down to Continue; confirm loads the finale_merge_start manual slot.
THE PREMISE: the ending is owed on load -- seal_resolved banked, finale_played absent -- and nothing has drawn the curtain yet.
== THE NIGHT == one interact on the bed at (9,2) facing up. sleep_beat.run() reaches the [Spellsword] gate (warrior 10 + mage 11) and RETURNS EARLY at the offer, so no other beat lands.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: The veil voices the offer (one line) and holds the prompt behind itself until it finishes.
THE STAND-DOWN: the bed hook declines while the merge choice is on screen -- the finale's black must never fall over that modal.
== DECLINE == row 1 is 'Keep them apart'; the prompt's own cursor starts at row 0 ('Consolidate into [Spellsword]').

THE RETRY: resolving the offer re-attempts the owed finale THAT SAME NIGHT, rather than making the player sleep again. The hook is DEFERRED, so this lands on the far side of decline_consolidation()'s whole synchronous chain -- CONSOLIDATION_DECLINED is emitted BEFORE _resolve_evolutions(), and the recount must read one settled snapshot (identically in QA and in play). 10 lines = 2 open + 3 class recount (Warrior 10, Mage 11 -- the merge was declined, so BOTH parents survive -- plus Diplomat 1) + 3 region recap + 1 FED close + 1 wanderinginn.com curtain.
